target_customer: Colleges, universities and employers needing to track COVID-19 tests, vaccines and symptoms to clear people for campus or work
problem: Organizations reopening in 2020 and 2021 needed one place to verify testing, vaccination and symptom compliance.
business_model: B2B SaaS licensed to institutions (pricing not found)
product_category: COVID-19 compliance and campus clearance software

technical_complexity.rationale: Forms, result uploads, status badges and mobile apps are standard engineering; hard parts were health data privacy and integrating many labs.

defensibility.rationale: Campus deployments and integrations created some lock in but the product depended on a temporary pandemic need.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many vendors (health record and background check firms) added vaccine verification in 2021; CoVerified itself is listed Inactive.

market_need_then: Colleges reopened in fall 2020 with testing and symptom reporting requirements; the app was used by campuses such as Salem State, Trinity College and Landmark College per their pages.

branding.domain_note: Used coverified.us per search results; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: Wordmark with a check mark in place of a letter, seen in campus tutorials

brand_strength.rationale: Known on campuses that deployed it, with no wider press or community; the name was tied to a COVID era need.

outcome_analysis: CoVerified sold COVID-19 compliance software to campuses and expanded to OSHA mandate compliance in December 2021, then is listed Inactive. No shutdown announcement or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public; the demand likely faded with the pandemic but that is not sourced, so failure factors stay empty.
notes: Seed 130K rests on one database (CB Insights), which also says founded 2017; Employbl says 2020 (YC page 2020). Company website not available (YC page lists none). Competitor search returned only 2021 vendor pages after or without clear dates (Medicat October 2021), so the list is empty. Founders: the YC page lists four.
